reason: Provides three external ChatGPT Codex-backed model tools for public web search, bitmap image generation, and workspace-local image analysis; the README clearly documents network access, credential use, and image transmission.

summaries.zh: 通过现有的 ChatGPT/Codex 登录提供网页搜索、位图生成和工作区内图片分析工具。
summaries.en: Provides web search, bitmap image generation, and workspace-local image analysis through an existing ChatGPT/Codex login.

capabilities: Searches the public web and returns model-generated summaries with source URLs
Generates bitmap images through the ChatGPT Codex endpoint
Reads workspace-local image files and sends them to the ChatGPT Codex endpoint for descriptions or answers
Uses existing Codex or ChatGPT credentials and may refresh and persist authentication state
Requires network access to external authentication and model services
